    assert reverse_delete("abcdef", "xyz") == ("abcdef", False)

    # Palindrome results
    assert reverse_delete("abcdedcba", "ab") == ("cdedc", True)
    assert reverse_delete("ababab", "b") == ("aaa", True)
    assert reverse_delete("abcdedcba", "abcd") == ("e", True)

    # No characters removed
    assert reverse_delete("hello", "") == ("hello", False)
    assert reverse_delete("racecar", "xyz") == ("racecar", True)

    # All characters removed
    assert reverse_delete("abc", "abc") == ("", True)
    assert reverse_delete("abc", "cba") == ("", True)

    assert reverse_delete("", "a") == ("", True)

    # Single character cases

    # Repeated characters in c

    # Case sensitivity check
    assert reverse_delete("AaBb", "A") == ("aBb", False)

    assert len(result) == 2
